about: The telegraph kit (docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md item 3): named blows any zone casts on a foe with one call (Battle.Tell, logic/Sim/Tells.cs). Each number is described in logic/Content/Telegraphs.cs. Damage is a fraction of her max life (before her armor), so it is the same at every tier. The kind names (ring, charge, pull, closing) are H3's sound bank's keys: telegraph.<kind>.windup / .land. Never rename them.

waves.about: Where the arena's table nights cast the kit (logic/Play/Zones/ArenaRun.cs): only at these tiers, past this minute of the night, never on a story night or while the boss is up.
